essence: Long tone, undivided mind: supreme-sky body at limit.
Body-mantra's gross course ends moon-drop: void-uttering, Śiva.
Own body as all directions: undirected mind, sky proceeds.
Back, root voids contemplated: body-disregard, void-minded.
Back, root, heart voids steady: thoughtless-rising from thoughtlessness.
Mere moment's voidness: sharing thoughtless nature.
Body-stuff gone, sky-pervaded: contemplation grows steady.
Skin as wall, nothing inside: the unmeditated-sharer.
Lotus-casket mid: undivided, supreme fortune won.

rasa.justification: Ten practices in a row, each producing a quieter noun — sky, Śiva, void-minded, thoughtless, steady, fortune — the song's whole arc is a descent into stillness.

sections.SUMMARY: The void-block: ordered sound seating sky-body at its limit; body-mantra ending in moon-drop void-utterance; own body taken as all directions; back and root voids yielding void-mind, heart-void added for thoughtless-rising; a moment's voidness making one thoughtless in nature; sky-pervasion steadying contemplation; skin read as wall until even the meditated drops; the lotus-casket mid-point winning fortune; and mind's twelve-end dissolving firming the reality-mark.
sections.FUNCTION: Multiplies void-contemplation into a full map of locations — sound, body, wall, lotus, twelve-end.
sections.KEY TERMS: śūnya (void as active, not negation); padma-sampuṭa (lotus-casket); dvādaśānta (twelve-end); nirvikalpa (thoughtless); dravya (body-stuff).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Purifies the field the fire-practices (p06) then pass through; twelve-end reappears at p10.
sections.BOUNDARY: The unmeditated-sharer's status is stated, not explained — no metaphysics added.
sections.EXPLANATION: A cartography of emptiness: the same void seen from ten angles — acoustics (long tone at the perceptual limit), mantra anatomy (gross letters ending in moon-drop), proprioception (all directions as one body), anatomy (back, root, heart), duration (a single moment suffices), wall-illusion (skin dividing inner from nothing), the casket mid-point, and the twelve-end where mind's dissolving writes the reality-mark firm. Each practice both negates a location and claims a steadiness — nothing is left to stand on, and the standing improves.
sections.RELATED: Hareesh central-channel block (vv28-30) precedes; Kṣemarāja on śūnya-methods; same void-word as the oṃ-practice at p04's end.
